# Existek

> Existek is an offshore software development company specializing in custom enterprise solutions, dedicated teams, and full-cycle development across web, mobile, desktop, and AI technologies.

Existek provides comprehensive software development services with expertise in modern technology stacks including Node.js, .NET, Java, React, Angular, and Flutter. The company serves enterprises, startups, and ISVs with dedicated development teams, custom software solutions, and industry-specific expertise in ERP, CRM, SaaS, and business automation.
